title: UNDERCROFT FLOOR CLEARANCE
why: The critic found the toast covering the new hint chips, title text crossing the wall seam, and cramped dim station plates.
now: Hub toasts clear the hints, the title has a panel, and station names have cream text and padded bordered plates.

edits.replacement: body:not(:has(.modal.on)):not(:has(#hub.on)):not(:has(#title.on)):not(:has(.outcome.on)):not(:has(.pausebox.on)):not(:has(#attract.on)) #hubtoast{ bottom:var(--hub-floor-toast-bottom, 150px); } /* v28.xx (cw-cx-hubfloorclear): floor toast clears the canvas hints at any menu zoom. */
